coder_notes: Glioblastoma is named only in inclusion criteria notes (GBM or other CNS tumours may participate; RANO measurability for GBM), not in conditions or title; coded basket_gbm_eligible under D27B. Pembrolizumab role is uncertain (see flag); DCSZ11 has a monotherapy escalation arm so coded experimental_monotherapy. Doxorubicin and tebentafusp are SOC partners in sarcoma and uveal melanoma cohorts only. Known driver mutations (EGFR, BRAF V600E, ROS1, NTRK, ALK) are exclusions in the NSCLC cohort and were not coded as biomarkers. Tumour PK: PK planned but sample type not stated; paired biopsies exist but are tied to pharmacodynamics. GBM patients are exempt from the biopsy requirement.
